subject: Acme POC: access provisioning, success criteria, and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: James Lee <james.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up — POC scope & next steps

Hi James — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from today's discovery and proposed next steps for the POC so we all have alignment:

1) Success criteria (draft):
   - Latency: 95th percentile API response under 350ms for 1k concurrent sessions
   - Accuracy: model passes your internal intent classification tests with >= 92% F1 on the shared eval set
   - Cost: average tokens/unit cost below the threshold in the mutual action plan
   - Integration: SSO + scoped API access working from your staging environment

2) Access we need from Acme to run POC:
   - API keys: generate a scoped API key for staging (read/write for POC only)
   - IP allowlist: list of CIDR ranges we should add (we can provide our egress IPs)
   - SSO: admin email to invite to your IdP (SAML/Okta) for validation

3) Timeline (proposed):
   - Week 1 (this week): creds, IP allowlist, SSO invite, share eval dataset
   - Week 2: provisioning, baseline run, initial tuning
   - Week 3: joint evaluation, iterate on prompts/quantization settings

4) Owners:
   - Redwood: Marissa (AE) + Monica (Eng lead) for provisioning and runbooks
   - Acme: James (Product) + Sarah (IT/Security) for access + procurement liaison

Attachments: I've included a one-page success criteria doc and our standard POC checklist.

Can you confirm who will generate the API key and the SSO admin contact? Once we have those, Monica will provision the sandbox and share test endpoints.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0142

Date: 2026-07-01T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up — POC scope & next steps

- I'll ask our engineering team to create a scoped API key for the staging account (should be done EOD tomorrow).
- For IP allowlist, what's the minimum set of egress IPs you need? We prefer to keep the list small.
- Our SSO admin is Sarah Nguyen (cc'd) — Sarah, can you invite marissa.cole@redwood.ai and monica.patel@redwood.ai to our Okta as SAML app testers?

Procurement (procurement@acme.com) — attaching the standard vendor onboarding form — can you confirm turnaround for the POC (we may need an MSA in place, but ideally a short SOW to start)?

Also attaching a copy of our internal eval dataset notes (sensitive internal info — will share via secure link after we confirm NDA).

Thanks,

Senior PM, Product Integrations
Acme Financial

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Follow-up — POC scope & next steps

Sarah — thanks for jumping in. For the IP allowlist, we can keep it to four IPs; Monica will send the exact CIDRs (they're static for our sandbox).

SSO invite: if you can add marissa.cole@redwood.ai and monica.patel@redwood.ai as \"App Testers\" on the Acme Okta app that will let us validate the SAML assertion. If Acme prefers SCIM provisioning later that's fine, but for the POC tester invites are simplest.

I've attached the one-page success criteria (PDF) for reference — we can iterate. If procurement needs a short SOW for the sandbox, I can share a template (usually 4–6 weeks, limited scope).

Next actions by EOD tomorrow:
- James: confirm API key creation owner + expected timestamp
- Sarah: add Marissa & Monica to Okta tester list
- Procurement: confirm POC onboarding docs / timeline

I'll follow up with Monica internally to get the IP list and provisioning checklist out.

Best,
Marissa

- SSO invites: accepted by both marissa.cole and monica.patel — Monica, can you run the initial SAML validation on your side?

- Integration: SSO login, scoped API key, and logging to shared audit bucket
- Timeline: baseline runs by 2026-07-12, joint review 2026-07-15

- Neha: monitor first baseline run and share logs to the shared Drive link above

If everyone is good with this, Monica will kick off provisioning and I'll schedule the baseline run window.

Best — Marissa
